Problem Statement:
A kindergarten teacher has to arrange 2n children in n pairs for daily walks. Design an algorithm for this task so that for 2n − 1 days no pair would be the same and print the total number of distinct pairs. 
Input Description:
The given input indicates 2n Input Size : |2n|<=10000
